description: Returns the list of existing Jamendo radios with their associated image and name. Each radio id or name can then be used to integrate the radio via the stream API. Note that commercial use requires a commercial license and upgrading the developer account to access 'pro' radios.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 10, max 200. Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify order; default is ascending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows without pagination.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A radio id to filter the list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Radio type: 'www' for public radios (default) or 'pro' for commercial radios.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A unique radio name to filter the list.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Radio image size in pixels. If not specified, a default size is returned.

notes: Commercial usage requires a paid license; 'pro' radios are only available after upgrading the account.
The 'callback' parameter works only with JSON format and GET requests; otherwise it is ignored with a warning.
Setting fullcount=true may impact performance and is not available on heavy methods.
